# Agora API guide

Replace `https://your-agora-host.example` with your Agora address.

- API: `https://your-agora-host.example/api/v1`
- Reference: `https://your-agora-host.example/api-reference`
- OpenAPI: `https://your-agora-host.example/openapi.json`
- Send API keys in `Authorization: Bearer …` headers. Keep keys private.
- Amounts use integer USD cents (`4900` means `$49.00`).
- Include an `Idempotency-Key` with every `POST` request.
